verses.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाच।  तां निशां दुःखशोकार्तौ निःश्वसन्ताविवोरगौ।  निद्रां नैवोपलेभाते वासुदेवधनञ्जयौ ॥१॥
नरनारायणौ क्रुद्धौ ज्ञात्वा देवाः सवासवाः।  व्यथिताश्चिन्तयामासुः किंस्विदेतद्भविष्यति ॥२॥
verses.english: The gods together with Indra himself, understanding Partha and Narayana to be excited with rage, became anxious and they began to think-what will come of it?

verses.sanskrit: ववुच्च दारुणा वाता रूक्षा घोराभिशंसिनः। सकबन्धस्तथाऽदित्ये परिघः समदृश्यत ॥३॥
verses.english: Dry and dreadful winds, portending calamities, began to blow. A headless trunk and a bludgeon became manifest in the solar disc.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्काशन्यश्च निष्पेतुः सनिर्घाताः सविद्युतः। चचाल चापि पृथिवी सशैलवनकानना ॥४॥
verses.english: Although the sky cloudless, thunderbolts fell on the earth, accompanied by dreadful rumbling the flashes of lightning; and the Earth with her mountains, hills and forests, began to quake.

verses.sanskrit: चुक्षुभुश्च महाराज सागरा मकरालयाः।  प्रतिस्स्रोतः प्रवृत्ताश्च तथा गन्तुं समुद्रगाः ॥५॥
verses.english: 0 mighty monarch, the oceans, the abode of the numerous acquatic creatures, became agitated; and the ocean-going rivers began to flow in directions opposite to their natural was courses.

verses.sanskrit: रथाश्वनरनागानां प्रवृत्तमधरोत्तरम्।  क्रव्यादानां प्रमोदार्थं यमराष्ट्रविवृद्धये ॥६॥
verses.english: The lower and upper lips of car-warriors, horses, men and elephants began to tremble, indicating, as if, a great festivity for the fleshcaters and an increase of the population of Death's domain.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनानि शकृन्मूत्रे मुमुचू रुरुदुश्च ह। तान् दृष्ट्वा दारुणान् सर्वानुत्पाताँल्लोमहर्षणान् ॥७॥
verses.english: The animals on the field began to discharge excreta and urine and they began to wail aloud. Beholding all those dreadful portents capable of making the hair stand on end.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते व्यथिताः सैन्यास्त्वदीया भरतर्षभ। श्रुत्वा महाबलस्योग्रां प्रतिज्ञां सव्यसाचिनः ॥८॥
अथ कृष्णं महाबाहुरब्रवीत् पाकशासनिः। आश्वासय सुभद्रां त्वं भगिनीं स्नुषया सह ॥९॥
स्नुषां चास्या वयस्याश्च विशोकाः कुरु माधव।  साम्ना सत्येन युक्तेन वचसाऽश्वासय प्रभो ॥१०॥
verses.english: O Madhava, go, assuage the grief of my daughter-in-law and her companions; O lord, console them with your soft words fraught with truth.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्जुनगृहं गत्वा वासुदेवः सुदुर्मनाः।  भगिनीं पुत्रशोकार्तामाश्वासयत दुःखिताम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Thereat the son of Vasudeva with a depressed heart, going to the pavilion of Arjuna, began to comport his sorrowful sister afflicted with the grief caused by the death of her son.

verses.sanskrit: वासुदेव उवाच। मा शोकं कुरु वार्ष्णेयि कुमारं प्रति सस्नुषा।  सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भीरु निष्ठैषा कालनिर्मिता ॥१२॥
verses.english: The son of Vasudeva said O daughter of the Vrishni race, do not grieve, with your daughter-in-law, for your son. O timid lady, the self-same end is ordained by the Destroyer for all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: कुले जातस्य धीरस्य क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः। सदृशं मरणं ह्येतत् तव पुत्रस्य मा शुचः ॥१३॥
verses.english: This sort of death is worthy of your son, born in an illustrious family, modest and especially belonging to the Kshatriya order. Do not grieve for him.

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या महारथो धीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः।  क्षात्रेण विधिना प्राप्तो वीराभिलषितां गतिम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Indeed it is through good fortune that mighty car-warrior, modest and equal to his father in prowess, has obtained the goal coveted by the heroes, in consequence of his observance of Kshatriya duties.

verses.sanskrit: जित्वा सुबहुशः शत्रून् प्रेषयित्वा च मृत्यवे।  गतः पुण्यकृतां लोकान् सर्वकामदुहोऽक्षयान् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Vanquishing innumerable foes and dispatching them to the abode of Death, he as attained to the posthumous state of the pious, that is enduring and in which all desires become fruitful.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन प्रज्ञयाऽपि च।  सन्तो यां गतिमिच्छन्ति तां प्राप्तस्तव पुत्रकः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Your son of tender years has attained to that end which the pious desire to have through the performance ascetic austerities and Brahmacharya and through knowledge of the Shastras and wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: वीरसूर्वीरपत्नी त्वं वीरजा वीरबान्धवा।  मा शुचस्तनयं भद्रे गतः स परमां गतिम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: You are the mother of a hero, the wife of a hero, the daughter of a hero and a kins-woman of the heroes: O amiable one do not bewail your son who has attained an excellent mode of existence.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्स्यते चाप्यसौ पापः सैन्धवो बालघातकः। अस्यावलेपस्य फल ससुहृद्गणबान्धवः ॥१८॥
verses.english: That wretched and sinful ruler of the Sindhus, that murderer of an infant, shall soon reap the fruit of this arrogance, with his relations and kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: व्युष्टायां तु वरारोहे रजन्यां पापकर्मकृत्।  न हि मोक्ष्यति पार्थात् स प्रविष्टोऽप्यमरावतीम् ॥१९॥
verses.english: O beautiful lady, when the day dawns, that perpetrator of sinful acts, shall not escape the son of Pritha, even if he seeks shelter in Heaven itself.

verses.sanskrit: श्वः शिरः श्रोष्यसे तस्य सैन्धवस्य रणे हृतम्। समन्तपञ्चकाद्बाह्यं विशोका भव मा रुदः ॥२०॥
क्षत्रधर्मं पुरस्कृत्य गतः शूरः सतां गतिम्।  यां गतिं प्राप्नुयामेह ये चान्ये शस्त्रजीविनः ॥२१॥
verses.english: Keeping in the view duties of the Kshatriya order, that hero has obtained the end of the pious, end, which we also will meet with, as also many other men who live by their weapons.

verses.sanskrit: व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुरनिवर्ती रथप्रणुत्। गतस्तव वरारोहे पुत्रः स्वर्गं ज्वरं जहि ॥२२॥
अनुयातश्च पितरं मातृपक्षं च वीर्यवान्।  सहस्रशो रिपून् हत्वा हतः शूरो महारथः ॥२३॥
आश्वासयन्स्नुषां राज्ञि मा शुचः क्षत्रिये भूशम्। श्वः प्रियं सुमहच्छ्रुत्वा विशोका भव नन्दिनि ॥२४॥
verses.english: O queen, comfort your daughter-in-law; () daughter of a Kshatriya, do not lament, Dismiss your sorrow, O my beloved sister, as in the morrow you will hear such agreeable news.

verses.sanskrit: यत् पार्थेन प्रतिज्ञातं तत् तथा न तदन्यथा।  चिकीर्षितं हि ते भर्तुर्न भवेज्जातु निष्फलम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: What the son of Pritha has vowed shall be accomplished and cannot be otherwise. What your husband has set his heart upon, cannot remain undone.

verses.sanskrit: यदि च मनुजपन्नागाः पिशाचा रजनिचराः पतगाः सुरासुराश्च।  रणगतमभियान्ति सिन्धुराजं न स भविता सह तैरपि प्रभाते ॥२६॥
